name: Kegarenaki Kimi o ~Tenshi to Akuma no Hazama~
original_name: 穢れなき君を ～天使と悪魔の狭間～
source:
Hero is an exorcist. In the middle of one exorcist act the evil spirit possesses his wife who bears three unborn triplets and it's impossible to know who of the children got possessed...

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-february-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
英雄是驱魔师。在一次驱魔表演中，邪灵附身了他的妻子，她还生了三个未出生的三胞胎，而且无法知道孩子中的谁被附身了……

[来自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.ru/2017/10/vn-of-month-february-1999.html]vndbreview[/url]]
